title: Upstream crosslink observation: issue show --json 'subissues' is never populated
description:
For operator relay to the crosslink project.

Observation: 'crosslink issue show <id> --json' returns 'subissues: []' for every issue checked, even for issues that provably have children — e.g. #745 has children #752/#753/#754 (each carries 'parent_id': 745), yet #745's 'subissues' is empty, and #754 (labelled 'review') also shows 'subissues': []. Parent linkage IS present and correct on the CHILD side ('parent_id'); only the parent-side 'subissues' array is unpopulated in the show JSON.

Verified: 326 issues carry a non-null 'parent_id'; 'subissues' length is 0 across every issue sampled.

Question: is the empty 'subissues' on 'issue show --json' intended (parent-side child lists not serialized), or a serialization gap? If intended, documenting it would help consumers; if a gap, populating 'subissues' from the parent_id index would let consumers walk parent->children without a full 'issue list' scan.

Impact on vsdd-cli: the finding-query join (#820, .design/finding-query-join.md) needed parent->child linkage to find a review round's findings. Because 'subissues' is empty, the walk instead uses one bulk 'issue list -s all --json' and filters on child 'parent_id' — functional, so this is not a blocker, just an efficiency/clarity note. Relates to #820.
